home_claims.statement: MetroGraph Visual Query Building for MongoDB is partially implemented with service infrastructure (MongoService) but UI component is not activated
MetroGraph does not implement Export/Download functionality; no serialization or file export mechanisms found in codebase
MetroGraph does not implement Undo/Redo functionality; no evidence of history management or transaction reversal in codebase
MetroGraph implements Visual Canvas & Editor with drag/drop and visual layout capabilities
MetroGraph implements Data Binding & Variable System with EditorService tracking changes and reactive state updates
MetroGraph implements Data Source Integration with MongoDB connection and MongoService
MetroGraph implements Edge Creation through integrated drag-and-drop and line-connection components
MetroGraph implements Edges & Data-Flow Connections using LeaderLine library with visual connectors
MetroGraph implements Graph Navigation & Exploration with node tree structure and parent-child relationships
MetroGraph implements Manual Positioning with drag component allowing free node placement
MetroGraph implements Node Creation & Palette with document/widget components spawned on dashboard
MetroGraph implements Node System with typed container components and node hierarchy
MetroGraph implements Execution Logs & Step Debugging with error tracking and summary visualization
MetroGraph implements Pan, Zoom & Semantic Viewport with resize and drag components for viewport manipulation
MetroGraph implements Node Properties/Inspector Panel with multiple viewer types (text, number, boolean, select, key-value, object)
MetroGraph implements Visual Query Building for MongoDB with field filtering and search interface
MetroGraph implements Schema Introspection & Discovery with MongoDB collection and field discovery
MetroGraph implements Auto-Layout & Rectangle Packing through RectanglePackerService with recursive bin-packing algorithm optimized for 10, 100, and 1000+ node counts
MetroGraph implements edge rendering and styling through DrawLinesService using LeaderLine library for visual connectors with customizable appearance
MetroGraph implements Execution Logs & Error Tracking with stack trace visualization, error grouping, and error summary components for debugging
MetroGraph implements MongoDB Schema Introspection allowing discovery of collections, fields, and nested document structure with field-path traversal
MetroGraph implements Multi-Selection & Bulk Editing through SelectedObjectsService enabling selection and tracking of multiple objects (containers, viewers, documents)
MetroGraph implements Node Styling & Theming through ColorService providing color management and visual customization for nodes
MetroGraph implements Performance Monitoring through ContainerRenderTimeService and PlotService tracking render lag, resize metrics, rectangle packing performance across different node scales
Every component is a live-editable JSON object with position/size controlled by signal-aware dimension system; editing JSON at any level updates state reactively via Angular signals

Layout engine uses signal-backed StateService with lenses to track dimensions (width, height, top, left) for every positioned element; changes to dimensions trigger computed() consumers and causality effects

JSON editability is declarative: ViewerMeta symbol attached to objects specifies field-level editors (text, number, toggle, select, readonly); changes recorded in EditorService and propagated to parent object state

components.name: Visual Canvas System
components.responsibility: Provides the main visual canvas/dashboard where nodes are rendered and manipulated

components.name: LineConnectionComponent
components.responsibility: Renders visual connection lines between selected key-value pairs and their target documents

components.name: Edge & Connection System
components.responsibility: Visual connection rendering between nodes using LeaderLine library

components.name: Drag & Resize System
components.responsibility: Enables drag-and-drop and resize operations for nodes on the canvas

components.name: Data Viewer & Editor System
components.responsibility: Multiple viewer types for data binding and property inspection (text, number, boolean, select, key-value, object)

components.name: MongoDB Query Builder
components.responsibility: Visual MongoDB query construction with collection/field selection and filtering

components.name: Observability & Metrics System
components.responsibility: Error logging, execution tracking, and performance metrics visualization

components.name: Data Integration Services
components.responsibility: MongoDB integration, global object store management, and data source handling

components.name: Node & Container System
components.responsibility: Core node/container abstraction with properties, state management, and composition

components.name: DashboardComponent
components.responsibility: Top-level viewport container (100vw x 100vh); manages document list, dev tools, error summary; listens to EditorService for live JSON edits (e.g. packer strategy changes)

components.name: ContainerComponent
components.responsibility: Base class for all positioned/sized elements; implements TStatefulEntity to participate in StateService; uses computed derivedStyle() that reads from DimensionService signals; manages lifecycle, event routing, and error propagation

components.name: DocumentComponent
components.responsibility: Wraps JSON objects/documents with title bar and drag/resize handles; resolves MongoDB document references; emits ObjectComponent for display; tracks selection and errors

components.name: Viewer (base class)
components.responsibility: Base class for all data renderers; computes getIntendedSize() based on data type; implements editable input with valueChange output; extends ContainerComponent for positioning

components.name: ObjectComponent
components.responsibility: Renders JSON objects by iterating entries and creating KeyValueViewerComponent children; computes child positions via rectangle packing; manages keyToComponent map reactively

components.name: KeyValueViewerComponent
components.responsibility: Renders a single key-value pair; conditionally renders key (text/object), value (by type), and pagination toggle; resolves editor type from FieldMeta; emits onValueChange() to EditorService; tracks selection and line connections

components.name: TextViewerComponent
components.responsibility: Renders string values in textarea; emits valueChange on edit

components.name: NumberViewerComponent
components.responsibility: Renders numeric values with optional slider or text input based on editor type

components.name: BooleanViewerComponent
components.responsibility: Renders boolean values with toggle control

components.name: SelectViewerComponent
components.responsibility: Renders enumerated values with dropdown selector from FieldMeta.options

components.name: ObjectListComponent
components.responsibility: Renders arrays of objects by iterating and creating ObjectComponent children

components.name: DragComponent
components.responsibility: CDK drag handler; listens to started/moved/ended events and updates dragElement's Left/Top dimensions via DimensionService

components.name: ResizeComponent
components.responsibility: Resize handle; calculates width/height deltas from mouse events; updates resizeElement dimensions; triggers causality effects and recursive size adjustment

components.name: ResolverComponent
components.responsibility: Template resolution; given a type, resolves template and context from ResolutionService

components.name: EditorService
components.responsibility: Tracks JSON edit history; recordChange() stores source object, path, value, prev; exposes latestChange signal for reactive consumers (e.g., DashboardComponent listening for packer strategy changes)

components.name: StateService
components.responsibility: Central signal-based state store; maps [TStatefulEntityID][key] -> signal(value); get/set/remove/removeEntity methods for tracking state; manages AbstractLense registration

components.name: DimensionService
components.responsibility: Signal-aware dimension lens; extends AbstractLense; reads/writes width, height, top, left via StateService; fires dimension change effects; core executor for layout updates

components.name: RelativeDimensionService
components.responsibility: Computes relative positioning of children; applies child slots and scaling/mimic relations; updates position when parent resizes

components.name: CausalityService
components.responsibility: DAG-based asynchrony control; factorizeCausable() creates handlers that fire effects only after all upstream causes complete; prevents race conditions and redundant computation in graph layout

components.name: EventService
components.responsibility: Event routing dispatch; maps component symbols to specialized event targets (ContainerEventTarget, ObjectViewerEventTarget, KeyValueViewerEventTarget); enables flow() propagation up component tree

components.name: AppComponent
components.responsibility: Root Angular component; entry point for router with RouterOutlet
